description: This file is an extension of the ChannelsStore class, providing lifecycle management functions such as starting/stopping polling, refreshing status, and handling WhatsApp and Telegram login/logout procedures. It interacts with an external GatewayConnection for network requests and manages various internal state variables related to channel status and login sessions.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginStartResult
classes.description: Structure representing the result of starting a WhatsApp login, containing QR code URL and message.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginWaitResult
classes.description: Structure representing the result of waiting for WhatsApp login, including connection status and message.

classes.name: ChannelLogoutResult
classes.description: Structure representing the result of a channel logout operation, indicating if credentials were cleared.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins polling task if not already started, loading config and schema, and managing the polling loop.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the channel status snapshot, handling errors and updating last success/error timestamps.

methods.name: startWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Initiates WhatsApp login process; optionally auto-waits for login completion.

methods.name: waitWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Waits for WhatsApp login to complete with a timeout.

methods.name: logoutWhatsApp
methods.description: Logs out of WhatsApp channel and clears credentials.

methods.name: logoutTelegram
methods.description: Logs out of Telegram channel, updating config status based on token environment.
